==Active Attack: Pale Sky==
[[File:MoonlessSkyIcon.png|80x80px|thumb|left]]
When used, {{PAGENAME}}'s Damage will increase by 900% (10x). however, he will be completely removed from the map after his next attack.


==Selling==
{{PAGENAME}} cannot be sold. However, using his ability removes him from the map, allowing you to place him again.
